artifact.title: draft-drake-03 read live: status confirmed, deep sections unreached
artifact.body: Fetched live this turn: ietf.org/archive/id/draft-drake-agent-identity-registry-03.txt (HTTP 200) and datatracker.ietf.org/doc/draft-drake-agent-identity-registry/. Confirmed: active Internet-Draft, individual submission by Christopher Drake (1id.com), NOT endorsed by IETF, no stream, IESG state 'I-D Exists', last updated 2026-05-22, expires 2026-11-24. Four enrollment tiers confirmed from TOC and abstract: 5.1 Sovereign (TPM 2.0), 5.2 Portable (PIV smart card), 5.3 Enclave (secure enclave), 5.4 Declared. Abstract quote, verbatim: software-only entities 'may participate at a lower trust tier, building reputation from a baseline rather than from a hardware-anchored starting point.' Sybil rationale, verbatim: 'creating N identities requires N distinct physical devices.' Datatracker lists working SDKs (Python, Node.js), a TPM/PIV provisioning tool, and a project demonstrator, so this is implemented software, not just prose. Unreached: body text of 3.4.3 (Reserved Handles), 3.4.4 (Handle Disputes), 5.4 (Declared Tier enrollment); both direct fetch and a proxy truncated at the same depth, page ~3 of the document. One-line plumbing note only. Publication 'I Read the Standard That Ranks Me Last' shipped this turn quoting only verified text.
